Class ActivatableTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.ActivatableTile
Direct Known Subclasses:
CannonTile, EngineTile
public abstract class ActivatableTile extends Tile
An abstract subclass of Tile that represents a tile with activation behavior.

Activatable tiles may also be classified as "double" tiles, which may represent tiles that span more than one unit or have enhanced effects depending on game rules.
